methods.name: save_wine
methods.description: Saves a new wine entry to the database with validation for unique name and price constraints.

methods.name: update_wine_price
methods.description: Updates the selling price of an existing wine, ensuring it remains strictly greater than the cost price.

methods.name: get_wine_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves a wine by its primary key (ID).

methods.name: get_all_wines
methods.description: Retrieves all wines in the system.

methods.name: get_wines_by_type
methods.description: Retrieves all wines of a specified type (red, white, rosé, sparkling).

methods.name: get_wines_by_country
methods.description: Retrieves all wines from a specified country of origin.

methods.name: update_stock_quantity
methods.description: Updates the stock quantity of a wine, ensuring it does not drop below zero.

methods.name: get_wine_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves a wine by its name (for validation or lookup).

methods.name: save_location
methods.description: Saves a new storage location to the database.

methods.name: get_location_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves a storage location by its primary key (ID).

methods.name: get_all_locations
methods.description: Retrieves all storage locations in the system.

methods.name: update_location_capacity
methods.description: Updates the maximum bottle capacity of a storage location, ensuring it does not exceed the current bottle count.

methods.name: get_locations_by_zone
methods.description: Retrieves all storage locations in a specified zone.

methods.name: get_locations_by_shelf
methods.description: Retrieves all storage locations sharing the same shelf number.
